summary_en: Kamgras 1 (offeror) tender offer for Kakaku.com: ¥3,000/share for ordinary stock plus ¥1/unit for multiple warrant series; minimum acceptance threshold 34,941,000 shares; period extended to 2026-07-22 (50 business days). Board maintains support for offer but withdraws recommendation to shareholders; takes neutral stance on shareholder participation.
title_en: Notice of Partial Amendment to 'Notification of Opinion Supporting and Recommendation to Tender in Relation to Public Tender Offer for Company Securities by Kamgras 1 Co., Ltd.'
translation_en_brief:
On 2026-07-08, Kakaku.com announced an amendment to its prior opinion notice regarding the Kamgras 1 public tender offer for the company's securities. The tender offer, which commenced 2026-05-13, targets complete privatization (非公開化) of Kakaku.com. The tender price is ¥3,000 per ordinary share and ¥1 per unit for multiple series of warrants (第８回～第20回新株予約権). The minimum acceptance threshold stands at 34,941,000 shares. The offer period has been extended to 2026-07-22, totalling 50 business days.

The board's stance has shifted: while maintaining its support (賛同) for the offer, the board has withdrawn its prior recommendation to shareholders to tender. The board now takes a neutral position, deferring the decision to participate in the tender to shareholders' own judgment. Warrant holders are similarly left to their own discretion on whether to tender. This amendment follows a July 2 board decision to extend the period and reflects subsequent corrections filed with the Kanto Local Finance Bureau on 2026-07-07.
